bf50b506ac205c37.description: We are looking for an 'Data Architect' for our client. Centralizing Data Architecture: Migrating scattered data from various systems into a centralized structure, building an optimized and enriching data architecture tailored for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) processes. Single Source of Truth: Establishing "Single Source of Truth" standards for cross-system data sharing; ensuring that customers are represented uniformly and consistently across all systems, regardless of their acquisition channel. Data Integrity Security: Designing secure data sharing protocols, as well as creating and deploying systemic rules to prevent data duplication. Data Governance: Defining Data Governance rules, guiding technical teams in their implementation, and ensuring continuous auditing and compliance.
